def factor_atr_ratio_fixed10(df):
    """Simplified volatility expansion: 10-day ATR / 60-day ATR, negative sign.
    Removes volume regime adaptation to reduce complexity and potential noise."""
    df_copy = df.copy()
    prev_close = df_copy["close"].shift(1)
    tr = pd.concat([
        df_copy["high"] - df_copy["low"],
        (df_copy["high"] - prev_close).abs(),
        (df_copy["low"] - prev_close).abs()
    ], axis=1).max(axis=1)
    long_atr = tr.rolling(60, min_periods=60).mean()
    short_atr = tr.rolling(10, min_periods=10).mean()
    ratio = short_atr / long_atr.replace(0, np.nan)
    df_copy["factor_atr_ratio_fixed10"] = -ratio
    df_copy["factor_atr_ratio_fixed10"] = df_copy["factor_atr_ratio_fixed10"].replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan).fillna(0)
    return df_copy["factor_atr_ratio_fixed10"]
description: Preserves the core parent mechanism: negative short-to-long ATR ratio captures volatility expansion that predicts underperformance. The bottleneck is potential ranking instability introduced by volume‑adaptive short window selection (5 vs 20) in the parent. Simplifying to a fixed 10‑day window maintains the economic signal while reducing complexity, aiming to improve RankIC and ICIR without sacrificing IC.
